msg_no_position_turn.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): the compass / direction button was tapped before GPS has a fix.

msg_routing_data_ready.context: Grey line at the top of Settings → Diagnostics → Developer tools: a routing-data download started by hand (missing-data screen / Developer tools) finished.
msg_routing_data_ready.doubt: 'Routing-Daten' kept as a technical word, like the English

msg_routing_data_stopped.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Diagnostics → Developer tools: the routing-data download started by hand stopped (not offline).

msg_routing_data_offline.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Diagnostics → Developer tools: the routing-data download started by hand waits for the internet.

msg_routing_data_progress.context: Progress line under the data buttons while routing data loads. %1$d = percent, %2$d = total size in MB.

msg_routing_data_present.context: Grey line at the top of Settings → Diagnostics → Developer tools: 'Download routing data' tapped but nothing is missing.
msg_routing_data_present.doubt: 'phone' = 'Handy' (friendly; alternative 'Smartphone' / 'Gerät') – used the same way in all messages

msg_routing_data_busy.context: Progress line under the data buttons right after 'Download routing data' was tapped.

msg_maps_remove_failed.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Offline maps: Settings → Offline maps → Clear all / Clean up failed.

msg_cleanup_keeps_plan.context: Item in the Clean up preview line 'Keeps: your current plan · saved routes · …' (joined with ' · ').

msg_cleanup_keeps_saved.context: Item in the Clean up preview line 'Keeps: … · saved routes · …'.

msg_cleanup_keeps_tour.context: Item in the Clean up preview line 'Keeps: … · running tour · …'.

msg_cleanup_keeps_position.context: Item in the Clean up preview line 'Keeps: … · where you are now': the map at the user's position stays.

msg_cleanup_not_possible.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Offline maps: the Clean up preview could not be worked out.
msg_cleanup_not_possible.doubt: 'Clean up' button – must match its German name on the Offline maps page ('Aufräumen')

msg_area_removed_after_tour.context: Status of one map area in the Offline maps list: it goes when the running tour ends.

msg_clear_all_blocked.context: Grey line under the disabled 'Clear all' button while a tour is recorded.

msg_maps_already_checking.context: Result line on Settings → Offline maps: 'Update maps now' tapped while a check runs.

msg_track_save_failing.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): writing recorded points fails during a tour.

msg_track_delete_failed_here.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): End tour → Delete could not move the track to the recycle bin.

msg_package_mixed.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK) at start or after a map import: imported map files do not belong together. %1$s = file names, comma-separated.

msg_update_check_failed.context: Line on the Updates page after 'Check for updates' failed (offline).

msg_update_allow_install.context: Grey line at the top of Settings → Updates (from the update banner on the map: not shown, the banner keeps Install): Install tapped, Android's 'install unknown apps' permission is missing (its settings page opens).
msg_update_allow_install.doubt: 'Install' = the button on the Updates page – must match its German label

msg_update_download_failed.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Updates (from the update banner on the map: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): the update APK could not be downloaded.
msg_update_download_failed.doubt: 'Install' = the button on the Updates page – must match its German label

msg_import_busy.context: Progress line under 'Import map data' (missing-data screen, Developer tools).

msg_import_busy_file.context: Progress line while a map package is imported. %1$s = file name inside the package (base.pmtiles …).

msg_import_restart_after_tour.context: Sentence added to the import result in the Developer tools line when new map files arrived during a tour.

msg_import_failed_unchanged.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Diagnostics → Developer tools (from the missing-data screen: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): a map package was rejected (no own reason given).

msg_import_failed_damaged.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Diagnostics → Developer tools (from the missing-data screen: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): a map package import failed unexpectedly.

msg_route_back_no_position.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): during a tour the destination was deleted, 'Route back to the start?' answered yes, but GPS has no fix yet.

msg_shared_place_not_found.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): a place shared from another app (e.g. Google Maps) could not be found offline or online.

msg_shared_place_unsure.context: Amber ⚠ box title (top of the map, stays until Search is tapped): a place shared from Google Maps had no coordinate and its name was found only in other towns (or several namesakes) – OnPath placed nothing.

msg_shared_place_unsure_detail.context: Detail line of that box. %1$s = the shared name + town, e.g. Olive Hilden (typed into the search when Search is tapped).

msg_shared_place_search.context: The one button of that box: opens the search with the shared name + town typed in.

msg_routing_failed.context: Red line on the plan sheet when the router failed without its own reason (rare).

msg_no_new_route.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): during a tour, a new route (after 'find a way back' / an edit) could not be computed; the old one stays.

msg_route_save_failed.context: Error line in the save dialog / My routes when saving a planned route failed (database).

msg_route_rename_failed.context: Error line in My routes when Rename failed.

msg_tour_delete_failed.context: Error line in My routes when Delete failed. %1$s = route / tour name.

msg_tour_restore_failed.context: Error line in the recycle bin when Restore failed. %1$s = route / tour name.

msg_name_route.context: First word of a default name: 'Route 26 Oct, 10:12' (save dialog, a route followed without a name). Followed by a space and the date.

msg_name_share.context: First words of the file name / subject when the current plan is exported as GPX: 'OnPath route 26 Oct, 10:12'.

msg_name_import.context: First word of the name of an imported GPX file without its own name: 'Import 26 Oct, 10:12'.

msg_name_date_pattern.context: Date pattern (Java SimpleDateFormat) after a default name: d = day, MMM = short month name, HH:mm = time. Letters are codes – only order and punctuation may change.
msg_name_date_pattern.doubt: German day with a dot: '26. Okt., 10:12'

msg_date_pattern_area.context: Date pattern (Java SimpleDateFormat) of a map area's date in the Offline maps list: '26 Oct 2026'. Letters are codes.
msg_date_pattern_area.doubt: German day with a dot: '26. Okt. 2026'

msg_recording_not_started.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): Start navigation / Start recording, but the recording service did not start within a few seconds.

msg_check_no_route_followed.context: Note at the top of the activity switch sheet during a tour without a followed route.

msg_check_waiting_gps.context: Note in the activity switch sheet until GPS has a position (the rest of the route is checked from there).

msg_check_nothing_left.context: Row text for every other activity when the followed route is already done.

msg_check_cannot_route.context: Row text for an activity when no router is available (map data missing).

msg_check_no_route.context: Row text for an activity the rest of the route cannot be routed with.

msg_rides_read_failed.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes: ⋮ → Rides of a recorded tour could not be read. Rides = bus / car / lift parts inside a tour.
msg_rides_read_failed.doubt: 'rides' = 'Fahrten' (bus / car / lift inside a tour) – must match the Rides dialog

msg_rides_change_failed.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes: saving the changed rides of a tour failed.

msg_track_delete_failed.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): deleting an unfinished tour failed.

msg_track_recording_now.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes: Delete on the tour that is being recorded.

msg_gpx_parts_skipped.context: Grey line in the panel of a just imported GPX track (stays with the track): parts of the file could not be read (details in Diagnostics).

msg_export_all_chooser.context: Title of Android's share sheet for My routes → ⋮ → Export all (one ZIP).

msg_export_reason.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes: Export all stopped for a known reason. %1$s = the reason (e.g. nothing to export).

msg_export_failed.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes (from the track panel on the map: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): GPX export or Export all failed.

msg_backup_failed.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): the automatic backup to Documents/OnPath failed. %1$s = what failed (from the backup, without final dot).
msg_backup_failed.doubt: 'Settings → Backup' must match the German page names ('Einstellungen → Sicherung')

msg_restore_looking.context: Progress dialog after a backup folder was picked for Restore.

msg_restore_folder_unreadable.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Backup or of My routes (restore offered at the first start): restore from the picked folder failed.

msg_gpx_import_failed_reason.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes (a file opened from another app: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): a GPX import failed with OnPath's own reason. %1$s = the reason sentence (e.g. 'No track, route or waypoint found in this file.').

msg_gpx_import_failed.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes (a file opened from another app: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): a GPX import failed (file unreadable).

msg_route_updated_newer_data.context: Grey line in the plan sheet (a tap shows the whole route; it goes with the next change): newer routing data arrived and the planned route changed.

msg_no_storage_permission.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Backup (Android 8–9 only): the storage permission was refused.
msg_no_storage_permission.doubt: 'Documents/OnPath' is the folder name on the phone (stays English); page names must match Settings

msg_no_folder_picker.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of Settings → Backup (from the restore offer at the first start: the error card at the top of the map, stays until OK): Android's folder picker is missing (restore / choose backup folder).

msg_something_wrong.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): a new serious problem was logged (once per problem).
msg_something_wrong.doubt: 'Diagnostics' page name in German ('Diagnose') must match the Settings list

msg_rides_title.context: Title of the Rides dialog (bus / car / lift inside a recorded tour). %1$s = tour name.
msg_rides_title.doubt: 'Rides' = 'Fahrten' – must match the Rides dialog wording

msg_unfinished_save_title.context: Title of the dialog that saves a tour left unfinished (the app was closed during recording).

msg_update_tour_title.context: Dialog title: Install tapped while a tour records.

msg_update_tour_text.context: Dialog text: Install tapped while a tour records.
msg_update_tour_text.doubt: 'Continue' = the button of the unfinished-tour dialog – must match its German label

msg_update_after_tour.context: Dialog button: install later (closes the dialog).

msg_update_install_now.context: Dialog button: install the update now, recording stops.

msg_shared_no_place.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): text shared to OnPath from another app had no place or map link.

msg_shared_unreadable.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): a place shared to OnPath could not be read.

msg_no_file_picker.context: Red ⚠ line at the top of My routes: Android's file picker is missing (Import GPX).

msg_crash_last_time.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): at start after a crash in the last run.
msg_crash_last_time.doubt: 'Diagnostics' page name in German ('Diagnose') must match the Settings list

msg_maps_checking.context: Result line on Settings → Offline maps: after 'Update maps now'. %1$d = number of map areas.

msg_maps_checking_wifi.context: Result line on Settings → Offline maps: after 'Update maps now' when maps load only on Wi-Fi. %1$d = number of map areas.
msg_maps_checking_wifi.doubt: The quoted setting must match its German label in Settings → Offline maps

msg_plan_link_unreadable.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): a plan link (QR code, shared or pasted link with #p=) is cut off, damaged or from a newer OnPath; the plan stays as it was.

msg_plan_link_after_tour.context: Error card (light red, ⚠, top of the map, stays until OK): a plan link was opened while a tour records – the followed route is kept, nothing is loaded.
